top_choice_rationale: P001 recognises a mature, independently confirmed chain from incretin physiology and proglucagon processing to the active GLP-1(7-36) peptide and agonists with replicated randomised evidence on glycaemia, weight and cardiovascular and renal outcomes. The three-name allocation (Drucker, Holst, Mojsov) is defensible, though Mojsov's priority relative to Habener remains the weakest point; the discovery-centred citation is coherent and the achievement clearly merits an award this year, so no award ranks below it.
